headlines.description: A quickfire brace from Alexander Isak ensured new Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola got off the mark at the third time of asking with a 2-0 win at Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak gives Iraola a Liverpool win as Barcola debuts

headlines.description: Substitute Jacob Ramsey struck late on as Newcastle came from 2-0 down to snatch a 2-2 draw against Bournemouth and preserve Matthias Jaissle's unbeaten start to his time on Tyneside.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob Ramsey scores last-gasp equaliser to salvage a point for Newcastle, Bournemouth drop points from winning position again

headlines.description: Enzo Le Fée scored a late penalty to rescue a point for Sunderland in a lively 1-1 draw against Brentford at the Gtech Community Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Enzo Le Fée scores late penalty for Sunderland in lively 1-1 draw with Brentford

events.name: Leeds United at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Brighton's club-record signing Luka Vušković headed his first goal in English football to earn a 1-1 Premier League draw at home to Leeds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teenager Luka Vušković rescues a point for Brighton in 1-1 draw against Leeds

headlines.description: Ben Chilwell celebrated his return to Crystal Palace with a late winner in their 3-2 comeback victory over Fulham at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulham win 3-2 at Palace as Chilwell scores at former club

headlines.description: Erling Haaland's first-half header saw Manchester City edge out Coventry 1-0 and make it three wins from three as Enzo Fernandez made an earlier than planned debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland scores only goal as City squeeze past Coventry

headlines.description: Tottenham earned their first point of the Premier League season after a 0-0 draw with Nottingham Forest, but things are still not clicking for Roberto De Zerbi's new-look side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs take first point of season in goalless draw with Forest

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten start to life back in the Premier League continued as Sergej Jakirovic's surprise package ended a breathless week by holding rebuilding Aston Villa to a 0-0 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull continue unbeaten start to the Premier League season following goalless draw with Aston Villa

headlines.description: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn a 2-2 draw against Manchester United and lift the mood at the end of a difficult week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Everton snatch last-gasp equaliser against Man Utd

headlines.description: Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premier League against his former club.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal beat Chelsea, maintain perfect start

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Coventry City
